reason: The whole pitch hangs on linking my bank through Account Aggregator, and I am not doing that for a brand-new app from one developer with zero reviews. Without the bank link I am back to typing spends, which I already half-do on Splitwise, so there is nothing here worth Rs 99 a month to me yet.
objection: I do not want to link my bank account to an unknown app. Even if AA is RBI-regulated, I have no idea who this solo developer is, where my data sits or what happens if the app shuts down.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews and a clear privacy page showing exactly what data is pulled and stored, plus the app being genuinely useful without the bank link (for example, importing my Splitwise balances) so I can try the free tier for a few weeks first.
